endorsements.name: Alexander Ermolov
endorsements.label: Untrusted Roots: exploiting vulnerabilities in Intel ACMs
endorsements.description: This talk will be all about security analysis of all known types of ACMs and how to exploit vulnerabilities in them (keeping in mind that they are sometimes encrypted and running only from L3 cache). Read more
